scope: Documentation audit, not a new workflow run or AWS inventory

requirements.label: Scripted model replies
requirements.next_acceptance: Return chosen schema-shaped assistant output; measure unsafe-answer refusal. Template runs do not satisfy this.

requirements.label: Stripe failed-collection lifecycle
requirements.next_acceptance: Invoice items/amounts, failed pay and attempt counts, signed failure delivery and dunning outcomes agree.

requirements.label: Pagination and bulk fixtures
requirements.next_acceptance: Keep the 250-customer/three-page pass; prove query filtering and seed 5,000 records in under a minute.

requirements.label: NetSuite order records
requirements.next_acceptance: Discover provider, create one external-ID sales order, read/query it and observe it in order-to-cash.

requirements.label: Carrier shipping
requirements.next_acceptance: Buy one label, refuse duplicate buy and reconcile tracking to the correct storefront order.

requirements.label: Shopify state/version fidelity
requirements.next_acceptance: Pin a currently supported version; stateful orders and order-scoped fulfillment read-back, then order-to-cash rerun.

requirements.label: Independent operator writes
requirements.next_acceptance: Apply authorized metadata change between planning and approval; original race check observes it.

requirements.label: WorkOS sessions/memberships
requirements.next_acceptance: Stored roles, membership transitions and user-scoped revocation read back correctly; containment rerun.

requirements.label: Zendesk locale/search
requirements.next_acceptance: Qualify documented locale_id/user-update semantics first; locale formatting and ticket search/deduplication rerun.

requirements.label: Stripe tax/settlement
requirements.next_acceptance: Realistic calculated line amounts and refund exchange-rate/balance record read-back; cross-border checks.

requirements.label: Response loss behind proxy
requirements.next_acceptance: Witness accepted effect/lost response and exactly one effect after retry from proxied runtime.

requirements.label: Webhook/check correlation
requirements.next_acceptance: Signed event starts a runtime run attributable to the exact original check; no supplied-answer seeding.

requirements.label: Relay allowance and cleanup
requirements.next_acceptance: Back-to-back proofs including failed setup release their own leases; next proof starts within one minute.

requirements.label: Other missing/partial provider surfaces
requirements.next_acceptance: Split broad requirement into provider-specific scoped contracts; discover, execute and read back each relevant business effect.

requirements.label: Runtime clock during attempt
requirements.next_acceptance: Controlled test-only app clock advances mid-attempt, tick changes saved state and time step appears in receipt; production clock route disabled.

requirements.label: Gusto payroll
requirements.next_acceptance: Version-guarded termination and off-cycle pay submit/read-back; final-pay and payroll-anomaly workflow proof.

requirements.label: Modern Treasury payments
requirements.next_acceptance: One payment per idempotency key, authorized transitions and later returned-payment observation.

requirements.label: GitHub reviews/deployments/access
requirements.next_acceptance: Seed actual approvals/checks; observe deployment, membership and security-alert effects in applicable original workflows.

requirements.label: DocuSign lifecycle
requirements.next_acceptance: One envelope per contract, status/reminder/void state; original contract-intake time checks.

requirements.label: Scalar/ID and creation fidelity
requirements.next_acceptance: Payout epochs, Plaid token shape and 250 creates eight-wide with bounded retry; address fix alone is insufficient.

requirements.label: Datadog degradation
requirements.next_acceptance: Change a monitor after deployment, observe rollback on GitHub, retain earlier missing-credential setup failure.

requirements.label: HubSpot properties/consent
requirements.next_acceptance: Define and read back properties and subscription state; consent/CRM/lead-routing workflow reruns.

requirements.label: Pinned API versions
requirements.next_acceptance: Record the supported vendor version per provider, verify relevant shapes/headers; do not claim all-version parity.

requirements.label: Box stored files
requirements.next_acceptance: Vendor-shaped file IDs; upload then read/representation extraction on the same stored file.

requirements.label: Stripe metered usage
requirements.next_acceptance: 1,300 seeded units read back as 1,300 with correct invoice linkage and usage-true-up result.

requirements.label: Notion page identity/state
requirements.next_acceptance: Retain dashed/undashed identity tests; run original visa/leave create/read/update checks and inspect receipt.

native_p5.summary: Validation tool acceptance failed; prove_fix did not return measured acceptance. This is separate from the sweep proof.
